title: The same question asked twice gets the same answer, on purpose
why: A customer who scrolls up and re-asks should get the same answer, worded the same way. The rubric's repeated_sentence rule is a heuristic for an agent stuck on a loop, and this is the case where the heuristic is wrong — so the finding is accepted by design rather than acknowledged as debt. Kept as a fixture so that distinction is a thing the suite holds, not a thing a reviewer has to remember.

turns.reply: Your order BK-1041 (Dune) shipped with Bookly Express and is expected by September 5.

accepted.why: Two identical questions have one identical answer. Varying the wording to avoid repeating myself would be a worse reply, not a better one — the facts did not change and neither should the sentence.
